name: Teets Cattle Company
old_description: At Teets Cattle Company, we believe simple is best. That’s why we take pride in raising our cattle and crops right here on our farm alongside our family. We work together as a family to provide food for our nation.
about:
Teets Cattle Company is a family-owned farm based in Lost River, West Virginia. The operation was established by Matt and Jill Teets, who run it alongside their three sons—Justin, JW, and Jordan. While the exact founding year is not publicly disclosed, the family has built a reputation around traditional values, a love of the land, and a commitment to hard work.

The farm raises beef cattle and grows crops, selling cuts directly to consumers through a farm-to-table model. In addition to daily livestock and crop management, the company organizes several annual community events, including the Bulls N’ Barrels Rodeo, the Teets/Griswold Mt Classic Production Sale, and the Teets/Griswold Pounds to Profit Bull Sale, which attract buyers and spectators from across the region.

Teets Cattle Company primarily serves individual consumers seeking locally sourced meat and agricultural buyers looking for breeding stock. Its production sales provide a venue for other cattle producers to acquire genetics, while the direct-to-table offering appeals to households in West Virginia and surrounding areas.

The Teets family emphasizes simplicity and stewardship as their guiding principles. They state that their approach—raising animals and crops on their own land, without intermediaries—reflects a desire to provide food for the nation while preserving the heritage of family farming.
